title: import id_from_timestamp can overflow to negative IDs
description: import.rs:446-453. The id_from_timestamp function computes (published_ms as u64) << 16 | (seq as u64 & 0xFFFF)) as i64. For timestamps after ~2004 (ms > 2^47), shifting left by 16 produces values > i64::MAX, causing the cast to i64 to produce negative values. Current epoch is ~1.7e12 ms, shifted left 16 = ~1.1e17, which is safely positive. However, if the import archive contains posts from far in the future (crafted data), or if the code is used after year ~4147, IDs will wrap negative. More immediately, if seq overflows u32::MAX (4 billion posts with identical timestamps), the saturating_add prevents further increment but all such posts get the same ID.
close_reason: Not practical. Overflow occurs in year 4147. Seq overflow requires 4B posts at identical ms. No real-world archive has this.
